page_header: Section A — Very Short Answer Question

steps.label: Heterochromatin
steps.why: RNA polymerase cannot reach DNA that is tightly packed, so density and inactivity are the same fact seen two ways.
common_mistakes: Saying heterochromatin is loosely packed. It is DENSELY packed.
Saying it stains light. It stains DARK.

steps.label: Euchromatin, and which is active
steps.margin_note: Mirror the first half, then answer the question explicitly in the last line.

lines.text: EUCHROMATIN is the one that is

lines: So of the two, EUCHROMATIN is the one that is
steps.why: Loosely packed DNA is accessible to the transcription machinery, which is why only euchromatin can be read.
common_mistakes: Not answering the final question. The examiner asked WHICH one is active — say it.
Swapping the two. Euchromatin is loose, light and active.
